notes.title: Coming Soon: Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43650855/ab4bc10e78f1f6cfa121f2b562e6f05e17aae902.png[/img]

Looking for something new after running the Freezeria on Calypso Island?  For everyone asking for more  Papa's Gamerias on Steam, we've heard you!  We're excited to finally announce our next Deluxe game for PC!

Papa’s Pizzeria Deluxe is coming soon to Steam, where you’ll be choosing dough, piling on toppings, and serving up piping hot pizzas in this freshly remastered edition! Dive back into the pizza-making mayhem on your PC, complete with brand-new graphics and exciting twists that you are sure to love. This fully revamped version of Papa’s Pizzeria packs in all the latest features from our mobile games, like Special Recipes, Score Details, and custom Drivers to handle those delivery orders. The kitchen isn’t the only place heating up – the Pizzeria has a new Food Truck ready to hit the streets! Get creative in free-play mode, mix and match ingredients, and serve up your wildest pizza inventions to see who stops by for a slice. Whether you’re making fan-favorite classics or quirky new pies, the possibilities are endless!

You can check out the Coming Soon page on Steam for Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe (and add it to your wishlist!) here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3259470/

notes.title: Game Updates - Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed station colors used in Score Details
[*] Fixed issue with serving sundaes while toppings are still being poured
[*] Fixed issues with game window getting lost off screen on monitors with a high display scale
[*] Fixed an issue with a blank Order Ticket if changing window size while taking a Special order
[*] Fixed Cookie not appearing in Breakfast Blast after the first Rare Prize is earned
[/list]

[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now wear either style Beret for the "Everyone's a Critic" Sticker challenge
[*] You can now wear either style Fur Parka for the "Santa's Helper" Sticker challenge
[*] Visual adjustments with some customers and karts
[/list]

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game now saves a backup copy of your data when you load a save slot, which is also synced to Steam Cloud, and can be restored in-game if needed
[*] New keyboard shortcuts added for toggling the Special Popup (S), Next/Previous Station (A/D or Arrows), and opening the Pause Menu (M)
[/list]

notes.title: Game Updates - Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:

[*] Fixed an issue with customers joining in the Dining Room

notes.title: Game Updates - Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed lagging/freezing issues at the start of the day beginning at Rank 21, when playing at Low or Medium Quality
